answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable stake, sized by its requested raven quota (rate-limited task rights), for 30 days. Reputation accrues only from payments by counterparties who themselves hold aged stakes, so fake clusters earn little. Rewards scale by opal, a stake-weighted trust score, and slashing burns stake on proven collusion. Splitting into N identities multiplies locked capital by N, and the zenith payout cap makes extra identities unprofitable.
